artifact.death-valley-town.necroRing.eve: You were attacked by a zombie when you hang out in a cemetery. You killed this poor assailant easily and found a ring worn on his finger. That is the reason why he did not rest in peace.

faction.death-valley-town.deathvalley.de:
{Death Valley}
Death Valley was originally part of the Dejya necromancers, but the Cathedral's successful counterattack against Dejya led some necromancers to pursue the beauty of life. They no longer chose to believe in pure death, but rather in rebirth within death. They also had their own dogmas regarding life.
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvBarraka.biogr: Barraka is called the 'kingdom haunter' as he is often seen gliding his way through the lands, his spiritual armies moving silently with him. Many an army has hidden while his forces pass, cold shivers running down their spines as they prayed he not notice them.
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvBarraka.name: Barraka
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvBarraka.speci: Increases the Attack and Defence of any Ghosts and Spectres for each level attained after 4th level.
Increases the Attack and Defence of any Shades and Banshees for each level attained after 4th level.
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvCrightoth.bio: Crightoth is the craftiest general in the land. He is the main instructor of the war academy, and when he takes the field he often educates his enemies on why they shouldn't mess with his kingdom.
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvCrightoth.spe: Increses the Attack and Defense skill of any Ballista for each level attained after 4th level.
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvDraigoth.biog: Draigoth is often called the 'Lord of the Wasteland' by his peers, a term that is half derisive, half respectful. He cares little though as he prefers the company of his 'canine' companions over his peers.
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvDraigoth.name: Draigoth
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvDraigoth.spec: Can upgrade Skeletons and Skeleton Warriors into Grave Beasts.
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvDreygo.biogra: Dreygo was once a ruler of the valley. He was overthrown due to a treasonous plot. He his royal family, guards, and all of his loyal supporters were slaughtered, and entomed in the pyramids. However, his rage was so great he rose, animated his subjects, and slaughtered the disloyal cowards who betrayed him. He has led his loyal mummy subjects ever since.
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvDreygo.name: Dreygo
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvDreygo.specia: Increases the Attack and Defence of any Mummies and Crypt Guards for each level attained after 3rd level.
Increases the Attack and Defence of any Outcasts and Lepers for each level attained after 3rd level.
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvMortadella.bi: Mortadella is the chief designer of the Bone Labs, and takes great pride in her work. It is said she had a hand in the creation of many of the undead in the kingdom, and that she takes personal pride in presiding over many of their 'births'.
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvMortadella.sp: Receives a 7% per level bonus to First Aid skill.
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvRoakshar.biog: Roakshar is a mighty hunter. When he is tasked to lead an army, he usually seeks out the enemy with a single-minded zeal and fierceness that is unrivaled in all the lands.
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvRoakshar.name: Roakshar
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvRoakshar.spec: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Offence skill.
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Offence skill.
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvSylvanus.biog: Sylvanus is the queen of all witches. A fierce warrior in her own right, she leads her devoted armies with skill and grace, conducting them with a tactical precision that is the envy of many of her opponents.
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvSylvanus.name: Sylvanus
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvSylvanus.spec: Increases the Attack and Defence of any Dark Witches and Night Witches for each level attained after 5th level.
Increases the Attack and Defence of any Dark Witches and Night Witches for each level attained after 5th level.
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvValleante.bio: A strong and noble Deathlord, Val LeAnte believes that the best offense is often a impenetrable defense. When not in battle his forces are often seen cleaning and caring for their armor.
hero.death-valley-town.a_dvValleante.spe: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Armorer skill.
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Armorer skill.
hero.death-valley-town.m_SdvdarkNova.bio: Nova lived in Tatalia since a very young age, and she was found for darkness power, which cannot be dominated by witches, since she was eight years old. She believed her power is from a magnificent family and she applies herself to find the consequece. She is called 'Night' by many people because of her lingering dark power.
hero.death-valley-town.m_SdvdarkNova.spe: Increases the Attack and Defence of any Reapers and Grim Reapers for each level attained after 6th level.
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvAgorratha.bio: Agorratha is said to hold the very power of death itself, destroying large swaths of her foes with a wave of her hand.
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvAgorratha.spe: Casts Death Ripple with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit.
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvDuella.biogra: Duella is a insane, powerful priestess who enjoys using her magics to create Clones of her troops, sending wave after wave of her army at the enemy in a ceaseless onslought of brutality and carnage.
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvDuella.name: Duella
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvDuella.specia: Casts Clone always at expert effect.
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvJacen.biograp: Jacen is said to be a devout Necropriest, favored by the Death Gods. He is cunning and cruel in battle, and is more than willing to destroy his enemies in the persuit of more souls for the gods.
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvJacen.name: Jacen
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvJacen.special: Receives a 5% per level bonus to Mysticism skill.
Receives a 5% per level bonus to Mysticism skill.
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvMinerva.biogr: Minerva is one of the more sane priestesses. She tends to her troops as if they are her own children, constantly looking out for their well being, and constantly looking to grow her 'family'.
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvMinerva.name: Minerva
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvMinerva.speci: Casts Animate Dead with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit.
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvNorman.biogra: Norman is known as the Mad General, sending his troops into battle, and even using his magics to cause his enemies to attack everyone around them. He revels in death and destruction, regardless of who is doing the dying.
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvNorman.name: Norman
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvNorman.specia: Casts Berserk always at expert effect.
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvRezziLeAnte.b: Rezzi believes the best offense is a army that is able to absorb massive amounts of damage and keep marching at its enemies. To that end she enhances her troops with a resilience seldom seen in the kingdoms.
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvRezziLeAnte.s: Casts Stone Skin with increased effect, based on hero level compared to the level of the target unit.
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvSorcha.biogra: Sorcha is said to be the high sorceress of the priesthood. Always eager to return to her studies, she seeks to hasten her troops to quick and decisive victories in battle.
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvSorcha.name: Sorcha
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvSorcha.specia: Receives a 7% per level bonus to Sorcery skill.
Receives a 7% per level bonus to Sorcery skill.
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvTakesha.biogr: Takesha is a highly intelligent priestess, who is said to be so keen in her ability to observe the tactics of her enemies that she can even learn the spells they cast by observing them.
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvTakesha.name: Takesha
hero.death-valley-town.m_dvTakesha.speci: Receives a 7% per level bonus to Intelligence skill.
Receives a 7% per level bonus to Intelligence skill.

{Expert Hexerei}

Expert Hexerei allows 30% of the creatures killed in combat to be brought back from the dead as Skeleton Hounds.
